## Recovered observations

174 points (from FA-6) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b2`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Inset D50 1.8 mm; D10 1.2 mm; Cu 1.6; D95 2.7 mm; all ranges printed ---; the average crosses 50 percent near 1.8 mm on the chart. Table 2-3 prints Cu 1.7. At page scale the F2-14 arrow labeled PS points to the square-marker curve crossing 50 percent near 2.4 mm (the RSM-a D50 of FA-18): F2-14 curve identity to be checked.
- Codex: Three samples; parameter ranges are blank; individual sample identities missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-6, printed A-13, PDF 14
